title: Universal Music Group: The Gatekeepers of Music - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 32]

reader_summary.headline: Today we’re breaking down Universal Music Group.
reader_summary.overview: Today we’re breaking down Universal Music Group. As one of the largest music businesses in the world, UMG is home to many of the world’s greatest artists, including Taylor Swift, U2. A discussion on UMG requires a deep dive into the history of music itself, how it was historically monetized, the shift from physical to digital.
